title: Run agent (prompt)
text: Trim native input and lock before asynchronous work.
explanation: The activity-scoped ViewModel retains prompt, result and timeline across lesson changes and configuration changes. The Node API independently validates input.

title: POST /api/agent/stream
text: POST JSON through a real native HTTP client.
explanation: OkHttp performs the request off the main thread. The configured public base URL belongs to Android; the Claude API key stays in backend/.env.
code:
suspend fun stream(prompt: String, onMessage: (AgentMessage) -> Unit): AgentResult = execute(request("/api/agent/stream", prompt)) { response ->
    var completed = false
    var finalResult: AgentResult? = null
    val source = response.body?.source() ?: throw ApiFailure("The API returned an empty stream.")
    SseReader.read(source) { event, text ->
        val json = JSONObject(text)
        when (event) {
            "error" -> throw ApiFailure(json.optString("detail", "The agent failed."))
            "done" -> completed = true
            "message" -> {
                val message = AgentMessage.fromJson(json)
                if (message.type == "ResultMessage") finalResult = AgentResult.fromJson(message.data)
                onMessage(message)
            }

title: Validate; tools disabled
text: Validate untrusted JSON on the Node server.
explanation: The HTTP adapter bounds actual body bytes and checks configured Origins. The handler verifies media type, JSON syntax and a trimmed 1–4000 character prompt.

title: streamAgent() / query()
text: Delegate a real Node route to the SDK service.
explanation: The Node process can run the CLI-backed TypeScript Agent SDK. Request disconnects abort owned SDK work and response writes respect backpressure.

title: Prompt; no built-in tools
text: Invoke the actual TypeScript Claude Agent SDK.
explanation: The SDK owns the model transport and CLI runtime. This source is the application boundary that initiates inference, rather than an invented provider HTTP call.

title: Model response
text: Observe SDK messages from the model exchange.
explanation: The same async iterator powers simple and stream modes. Tools, settings, skills, MCP, plugins and persisted sessions are explicitly disabled.

title: Safe SDK message
text: Project only safe SDK presentation fields.
explanation: Text, subtype/model and final metrics are allowlisted. Thinking, paths, tool arguments, session IDs and raw configuration are excluded; exact key occurrences are redacted.

title: SSE message event
explanation: Heartbeat comments and a three-minute deadline bound the stream. Request cancellation and reader cancellation clean up timers and abort execution.

title: Update typed state
text: Update native StateFlow with timestamped events.
explanation: The display cap does not prevent final result processing. LazyColumn renders timeline entries without mounting all rows at once.

title: ResultMessage fields
explanation: Non-success SDK subtypes remain errors even when is_error=false. Cost may be null, which the native screen labels unavailable.

title: SSE ResultMessage
text: Validate and dispatch the final ResultMessage.
explanation: Kotlin checks public message/result contracts before updating the UI. ResultMessage is a safe projection label rather than a raw SDK class name.

title: Render answer + metrics
text: Render model content as native text and colored code.
explanation: Compose never executes model HTML. Supported headings, bold, standalone HTTP(S) links and fenced code become native components; unsupported markup remains text.

title: SSE done event
text: Require final result and done before resolving.
explanation: Okio and the SSE reader handle split UTF-8, CRLF, comments and multiline data. A done event never overrides the final error flag.

title: SSE error; no done
text: Emit a safe SSE failure without done.
explanation: Simple-mode failures return 502. Raw provider errors and submitted values do not enter public error messages.

title: Error + snackbar
text: Show a safe native error and snackbar.
explanation: Cancellation aborts OkHttp, which disconnects the server request. Finally clears the clock and unlocks controls.

title: Key: SSE error / input: 422
text: Reject missing credentials before calling the SDK.
explanation: Simple mode returns 503. Streaming sends error without done. Invalid input and missing keys never spend model credits.
